bibl.title: Two Old Nubian Inscriptions from Akasha West.
bibl.seg: 142.2 O. Akasha West sans No. d'Inv.
Vincent W.J. van Gerven Oei & Adam Łajtar, Two Old Nubian Inscriptions from Akasha West.
bibl.note: Two Old Nubian texts discovered in 1969 respectively in Rooms 4 and 46 (sanctuary) of the church at the northern end of a fortified settlement at Akasha West. - Ostracon. - Prayer on an altar.
